notes.title: New visual themes, Network System update, Improved Tutorials
notes.content:
- Now with 4 different themes (Meadow, Beach, Winter, Desert)
- Upgraded Network System EOS to latest version
- Improved/Fixed Tutorials with better visuals (mouse input)
- Removed minor bugs

notes.title: Added more atmospheric fog and fixed weapon assignment
notes.content:
- New atmospheric fog layer to improve mood
- Fixed weapon assignment for some characters

notes.title: Removed Multiplayer Bug with Undo/Redo
notes.content: - Fixed the multiplayer issue with the Undo/Redo system, now this should work more stable!

notes.title: Fixed Water System Issue
notes.content: - This update fixed the water system bug: The game crashed after a few minutes using the water background rendering

notes.title: Updated UI, improved AI loading time and online search system
notes.content:
- Removed some unnecessary code from the AI bots to speed up loading time (excluding football mode)
- Updated some UI elements
- Added a Casual to Rank search permission while searching for servers

notes.title: Updated UI and Translation Files
notes.content:
- Added deletion button in player data stats and other UI elements
- Updated language translation files for missing characters

notes.title: Fixed the Football AI and Time Display
notes.content:
- The time in the football mode is now displayed in minutes and seconds.
- The football AI was improved and is now more focused on the ball.
- Also the football AI gets affected by the Easy, Normal and Hard - Smartness Levels.
- The Super Crystals will now only show up for the current playing player, also in the AI mode.
